Breakfast

Jalapeño Popper Beef McMuffins

A breakfast sandwich with a lean beef patty, cheesy jalapeño egg, crisped English muffin and a little bacon. Prep six, chill, and reheat for a fast morning.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
35 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
9

Ingredients

  • 6 eggs, whisked with salt and pepper
  • Chives, chopped
  • 6 light cheese wedges or 90 g light cream cheese
  • 1 jalapeño, diced
  • 540 g extra-lean ground beef, formed into six 90 g patties
  • Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, sage, thyme and smoked paprika
  • 6 English muffins, toasted
  • 6 slices cheddar
  • 24 g cooked diced bacon or turkey bacon

Amounts are scaled from 6 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Season beef with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, sage, thyme and smoked paprika. Shape into six thin patties.
  2. Cook patties in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through to 160°F (71°C). Set aside.
  3. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Stir in jalapeño and chives. Cook in a lightly greased skillet over medium-low heat, gently folding until just set. Divide into six portions.
  4. Spread a light cheese wedge or a sixth of the cream cheese over each English muffin base. Add egg, beef patty, cheddar and bacon.
  5. Close with muffin tops. Serve warm, or cool and refrigerate promptly for meal prep. Reheat until steaming hot.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
